transcript.text: As we approach the one year mark of the
devastating wildfires that swept
through Maui last August , the US Army
Corps of Engineers has made significant
progress in its recovery missions which
have been funded by Fe Ma in support of
the community since August 11th ,
2023 more than 1300 U A
volunteers have supported critical
missions including temporary power ,
temporary school debris removal and
temporary housing . USA worked side by
side with its federal state and local
partners as well as contractors to
complete projects in record time . Much
of that is attributed to Maui locals
comprising nearly 80% of the manpower
in our missions since debris removal
began in Lahaina on January 17th . USA
and its contractors cleared 1378 of the
approximately 1399 residential
properties . It contracted to clear ,
this includes 1231 residential lots
that were returned to the county of
Maui , allowing homeowners to begin the
rebuilding process to date . The county
issued more than 40 permits to affected
residents for rebuilding . In addition
to residential properties . USA also
cleared 76 commercial lots of ash and
fire debris and more than 3080
vehicles were removed from the impacted
area and disposed of .
